# graphiant_site_lists (Data Source)

Lists all Graphiant global site lists. Unlike graphiant_site_list, this does not resolve each list's entries — only summary fields (see graphiant_site_list to read entries for a specific list).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_site_lists" "all" {}

output "site_list_names" {
  value = [for sl in data.graphiant_site_lists.all.site_lists : sl.name]
}
```

### Nested Schema for `site_lists`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-form description of the site list.
- `edge_references` (Number)
- `id` (Number) Site list identifier.
- `name` (String) Site list name.
- `policy_references` (Number)
- `site_list_references` (Number)
